document_title: Internal IT Administration Guide: Secure Remote VPN Setup, Onboarding & Policy
author: IT Operations, Security & People Operations Team

overview.purpose: Ensure full HIPAA compliance, bio-data security, smooth remote employee onboarding, and protection of intellectual property.

day_one_checklist: Complete identity verification and tax documentation via the HR portal (Workday).
Set up corporate credentials and activate Duo Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
Log into the internal IT portal and install the My_Bio_Medical Secure Client VPN.
Schedule introductory sync with assigned onboarding buddy.
Review and digitally sign the corporate Information Security and HIPAA compliance agreements.

standard_package: MacBook Pro or ThinkPad Enterprise Laptop (pre-configured with endpoint protection)
External USB-C Docking Station & Dual Power Adapters
Hardware Security Key / YubiKey (for high-privilege access)
it_equipment_allocation.delivery_process: Shipped via secure courier to the employee's registered home address 3 business days prior to start date.

benefits_enrollment.window: First 30 calendar days from start date
offerings: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
401(k) retirement plan with corporate match up to 5%
Health Savings Account (HSA) / Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Wellness stipend and mental health support platforms

buddy_programme.description: Every new remote employee is paired with an experienced team member outside of their direct reporting line for their first 90 days.
goals: Facilitate cultural integration and informal team introductions
Provide guidance on internal tooling, communication norms, and workflows
Offer a safe, confidential space for general questions

probation_period.duration: 90 calendar days from the official start date
milestones: 30-Day Check-in: Initial alignment, tool setup review, and early feedback
60-Day Review: Progress evaluation on initial small-scale deliverables
90-Day Final Review: Formal evaluation to confirm permanent status

steps: Navigate to the internal IT portal at https://portal.mybiomed.internal/downloads
Run the installer with local administrator privileges and follow the setup wizard.
Launch the application, enter the gateway address: vpn.mybiomed.internal.
Authenticate using your corporate credentials and push notification via Duo Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
Open Self Service via your applications folder or download the macOS package from the internal portal.
Run the .pkg installer and authorize it in System Settings > Privacy & Security if prompted by macOS Gatekeeper.
Open the application from your Applications folder, input your profile configuration file (.ovpn) supplied by IT, and click Connect.
Open your terminal and install the OpenVPN repository package: sudo apt update && sudo apt install openvpn network-manager-openvpn-gnome -y
Import the corporate configuration profile via the terminal or network manager GUI: sudo openvpn --config client_config.ovpn
Enter your domain credentials and hardware token/MFA prompt when requested.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Incorrect password or expired Duo token.
troubleshooting.resolution_steps: Verify network credentials via internal IDP. Re-sync your Duo Mobile app.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Blocked UDP/TCP ports on home router or captive portal.
troubleshooting.resolution_steps: Switch connection protocol from UDP 1194 to TCP 443 in client settings.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Local DNS cache conflict with internal domain.
troubleshooting.resolution_steps: Flush local DNS (ipconfig /flushdns on Windows, sudo dscacheutil -flushcache on Mac).

unanswerable_scenarios_and_escalation.topic: Hardware Peripherals (e.g., Monitor Flickering / Docking Stations)
Facilities & Logistics (e.g., Office Parking Passes, Badge Access)
